verdict.rationale: Maritime is a cloud platform for hosting AI agents on micro-VMs, so a code-execution capability is a fair question for it. However, the evidence describes deploying Docker images as agents, Linux desktops and a Files API, not an API to run code snippets in Python, JavaScript or other runtimes and get rich results back. Running an arbitrary container as an agent is an adjacent hosting feature, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can execute code in multiple language runtimes (Python, JavaScript, and more) and get rich results back
